text:
elaine: tiny ask for runtime team  we need a focused data sanity probe for the launch blog. Not a full benchmark  smoke + a short variance slice (250 queries). Deliverables in 48h if possible.

sam: can do. please spell out exactly what to return so we package right.

elaine: minimal bundle: 1) per-request CSV (latency_ms, model_tag, tokens_in, tokens_out), 2) aggregate percentiles (p50/p90/p99), 3) cold vs warm delta heatmap, 4) README with seed file link + runner command (redact keys), 5) note if any fallback variant was used. If quantized run is possible include a single quantized trace.

peter: add: capture batch sizes observed and cache hit rate. also flag any requests >5s.

elaine: seed file: https://redwood.co/samples/launch-cohort-250.csv. baseline model tag rw-large-v1:2026-03-10. quantized candidate rw-large-v1-q4_0 if available. runner example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1:2026-03-10","input_file":"launch-cohort-250.csv","max_tokens":256}' 
please redact keys in the runner_cmd.

runtimebot: job scheduled jb_3123_mkt. est runtime 2.3h on staging-gpu-1. quantized kernels present on staging; may fallback to smaller variant under load. will record any fallback events.

sam: i'll own the handoff and slide packaging if artifacts arrive. success criteria: <1% errors and p99 within expected envelope. if quantized p99 > baseline by >15% mark as "do not use in headline" and note in appendix.

runtimebot: job jb_3123_mkt finished (2h19m). artifacts: /artifacts/jb_3123_mkt/ (latency.csv, aggregates.csv, heatmap.png, runner_cmd_redacted.txt, readme.txt). batch_mean=3.7, cache_rate=9%, quantized p99 = +13% vs baseline, 0 failures >5s.

sam: pulling artifacts and preparing a 1-slide summary + appendix text. ETA ~10h.

elaine: perfect  we'll feature baseline numbers, footnote the quantized delta (+13%) and include deeper analysis in the webinar appendix. thanks team.

peter: thx. tagging #sre if packaging needs review. :thumbsup:
